summary: An earthquake struck eastern Tehran lasting approximately three seconds, causing widespread structural damage and waking residents from sleep. Iranian missile attacks were directed toward US bases in Jordan following the Larak Island incident, marking escalated cross-border aggression. These developments mark a significant escalation in cross-border hostilities within the Middle East.
key_points: An earthquake struck eastern Tehran lasting approximately three seconds, causing widespread structural damage and waking residents from sleep (Source: @VahidOnline/78098)
Residents in Parchin, North Pars, and South West Tehran reported intense shaking that exceeded normal seismic activity levels (Source: @VahidOnline/78098)
A secondary tremor wave was detected in Markaz-e Tohir shortly after the initial quake, indicating prolonged ground motion (Source: @VahidOnline/78098)
Iranian naval forces launched two ballistic missiles from Imam Ali Base in Khorramabad province targeting Jordanian military installations (Source: @shin_persian/9237)
Iranian missile attacks were directed toward US bases in Jordan following the Larak Island incident, marking escalated cross-border aggression (Source: @Presstv/204827)
Additional ballistic missile launches originated from Urmia West Azerbaijan Province, extending Iranian strike reach further inland (Source: @shin_persian/9230)
